descriptions.g1c_sampling_flags_80086324: Sample eight original offsets from each external front/back byte buffer into the sixteen original scalar output words; OR0x7f00 into corresponding front/back pairs according to the witnessed flag order0,2,1,3 and bits1 then0. Compute the two original packed-lane averages with0xfefe masks. Receiver is an external prefix, with four consecutive witnessed flag words and two byte pointers, never constructed; offsets and destination words remain external and separately address-witnessed.
